text:
Petrol-fuelled cars produce oxides of nitrogen.
Which statement explains how oxides of nitrogen are formed?
A
In the catalytic converter, the elements nitrogen and oxygen combine.
B
Oxygen and nitrogen compounds in petrol combine in the car engine.
C
The high temperatures in the engine provide oxygen and nitrogen with the activation energy
needed to react.
D
In the car engine, nitrogen compounds in petrol combine with oxygen.
